HISTORY AND PHYSICAL - LABOR AND DELIVERY ADMISSION Cedar Ridge Medical Center Date: 05/23/2067 Pt: FROST, AMARIS MRN CR-4408216 Bed 4W-12 Written by: Elodie Marchetti, MS3, for Pilar Okonjo, MD
**NAME ALERT** another pt on unit with same last name: FROST, AMBER room 4W-17 - check 2 identifiers before every med!!
S: 39 y.o. G1P0 at term, presented to the ED w/ contractions q4min since the morning and leaking fluid. Ms. Frost's prenatal course was uncomplicated (visits monthly from October 2066). GBS swab done 05/09/2067 -- strep group B antigen result sent. Denies vaginal bleeding, headache, vision change. Past hx: recurrent UTI, chronic sinusitis, prediabetes, anemia (iron), prior concussion. No allergies. Soc: single, formerly bookkeeper at Pinecone Bookkeeping, mother Lorna visiting, supportive partner Devendra Rao at bedside, lives locally, finished college. Pt's chief concern in her words: "i just want the baby to be okay."
O: BP 128/84, afebrile. Gen: tired but comfortable between contractions. Abd gravid, fundal height 38 cm, cephalic by Leopold's. FHR 140s reactive. Cervix 4 cm / 80% / -1.
A: 1. Term pregnancy in early labor. 2. Prediabetes, diet controlled. 3. GBS status as above. P: Admit L&D. Augment labor w/ oxytocin per protocol. Continuous fetal monitoring. Pain plan epidural on request. Anaesthesia aware. Will update attending.
In conclusion, this patient's journey to motherhood is just beginning and she is brave. (Seen with attending, who agrees. Signed E. Marchetti MS3 05/23/2067 07:55)
